notes.title: Introducing... BONGO!
notes.content:
Ladies, low-lifes, and laser-eyed llamas. Tune in your forks and put down your sporks. This is HOT SHOT news. 

Introducing our newest nasty, BONGO.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35447878/9a4b445af4cbc848b19784405dc3e8a7a49762d3.png

Bongo is a bouncing ballistic baller bringing the bricks down with his… seafood… attacks. He tosses his lunch all over his opponents. (You do NOT want that cleaning bill.)

Bongo packs heat with his squid cannon, ready to blow cephalopods all over the map! Does he get up at like, 5am, go to the docks, and just buy a basket of these? What is the prep involved in this? Why not carrots? At least carrots are pointy…

We digress...

Bongo packs some serious punch, that is, when he isn’t banging on his bass (metal music sound)

This messy metalhead is available now along with 20% off on STEAM for limited time! Are we mad?! Yes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35447878/c2a87ff11c7311a052e75011504fdc302c437d73.gif

Wait, is that not enough meat for you, you bone-scraping vultures?

Well, pack your parkas and strap on your ski jets, you’ve won an exciting vacation to our winter wonderland. Enjoy a friendly snow-ball fight with your fellow contestants. Roam on the frozen tundra with wild bison. Take a walk down the glistening white avenues and enjoy in the sights of the great frozen north. 

Watch out for the murderous rampage going on all around you. 

Until next time, this has been another edition of Hot Shot News!

=======================================================

WELCOME TO HOT SHOT PATCH NEWS Vol 1! 

New Content


  Added new character: Bongo
  Added 3 new maps on Snowy Ruins of Kuleek setting: - Bisons strike back - Icy Ruins - Icicle Traps
  Added Russian language!


Bug Fixes / Improved Features


  Survive to win - you DO have to survive to win now. We also improved visibility for other contestants so you know which potential winners should be attacked in the first place.
 
 Explosions no longer kill through walls
 
 Characters shouldn't get stuck in warps anymore
 
 Balance Changes: - Fast reload got nerfed by 57% (now you reload 4 times faster, instead of 7) - Increased invincibility length after loosing a shield (up to 0.2 second) - Mutator probability decreased by 80% - Increased deathtouch radius by 5% to fit it's visuals
 
 Improved feedback on Power-ups - Changed colors and effects of power-up crates for better visibility - Deathtouch looks and sounds more deadly (and no longer kills through walls) - Less obstructing Fast Reload effect - Shield effect is more visible
 
 Replay readability improvements: - Hot win removed - Vote skip changed - Replay starting time shifted to show more action before last kill
 
 TV host dialogues fixed - he shouldn't ferhoodle contestants names anymore
 
 Additional Sudden death tweaks: - Increased visibility of the effect - Sudden death effect is persistent after you died - Walls gain speed while closing in
 
 Character movement while hidden in grass is now more visible.
 
 Decreased amount of matches required to unlock content from level 12 upwards.
 
 Umad's shield ability (when button has been pressed, not hold) lasts a little bit longer.
 
 Grass / bushes communicate characters' movement better - More visible entering and leaving - More visible movement while hidden in it - Improved sounds of movement - Grass / bushes are more visible (stand out from background)
 
 Sound positioning errors fix.
 
 Shortened transition between Score Screen and Gameplay.
 
  UI got many little tweaks.


Known Issues


 Weird things happen on 4:3 or 3:2 monitors (game is meant to be played on 16:9 screens)
 Umad, on very rare occassions, can shoot his bullet through a wall. It's a strange spiecies, this alien.

notes.title: Hot Shot Burn Out Now!

Grab your friends for a game night full of cartoon savagery, ridiculous flukes, and insane skill shots.  - Hot Shot Burn is out now on Steam Early Access!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/801750/Hot_Shot_Burn/

Watch the Early Access trailer:

https://youtu.be/Lc7VsakYZww

Hot Shot Burn is a top-down, hilariously violent party brawler where space gladiators compete in the galaxy's ultimate televised blood sport. Featuring:


 Fast-paced, unpredictable multiplayer action for 2-4 players
 Play on the couch, online, or both!
 Loads of arenas, each with unique hazards and rules
 Feel the effects of powerful mutators that can warp reality and turn a match on its head.
 Vibrant art style inspired by Saturday morning cartoons
 Powered the thumping tunes of SYNTHWAVEEEEEEE!

notes.title: Hot Shot Burn Officially Launches Tomorrow | What's New
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35447878/2e10df897fc3928db580bc1f1dc2ead9db12aadb.gif

Well ladies and gentlemen, the time has finally come. Hot Shot Burn is about to launch on Steam Early Access and we can't wait for you to experience the galaxy's ultimate televised blood sport.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/801750/Hot_Shot_Burn/

If you're brand new to the game then welcome! Help yourself to popcorn!

If you've been playing the Open Beta then here's what's new in the Early Access version:

 Two new characters - Chuck and Wizardo
 Eight new stages (taking the total to 12)
 3 mutators - random-chance events to shake up matches:
- Switcheroo! - players randomly swap places
- Nacho Time - big nachos are worth 5 points each
- Connection Problems - good ol' TV problems
 Unlockable character skins
 Vote to skip replays
 Text chat in lobbies
 Join matches already in progress
 Invite friends even if you're not the host
 Steam Rich Presence support
 Improved Discord Rich Presence support
 Additional languages (German, French, Spanish, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese)

A big thank you to all our Open Beta players for your participation and your feedback. And now... LET THE GAMES BEGIN!

notes.title: What We're Planning for Early Access
notes.content:
When they're not splattering each other with bullets (or goo) our Open Beta community has been asking what will be included when the game launches in Early Access on August 15.

At Early Access launch we'll have:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35447878/f7078b2fe581d75bfcb3bc42b3e155339f61d8b4.gif

- 6 playable characters
- 12 Maps
- Mutators that affect matches in unpredictable ways
- Unlockable character skins

Throughout the Early Access we will update the game regularly. Expect new characters, new maps, new game modes, fixes, and balance changes.

And finally, we strongly believe that if you pay for the game - you get everything it has to offer.

So all updates to the game will be free.

Head over to our Official Discord Server to find out more and join up for the Open Beta (if you haven't already) - https://discord.gg/HotShotBurn

https://store.steampowered.com/app/801750/Hot_Shot_Burn/
